headline: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting

meeting.body: Maui County Board of Ethics Meeting
meeting.summary: The Maui County Board of Ethics formed a group to review its gift guide and approved a press release on confidentiality.
meeting.recap: The Maui County Board of Ethics met at 12:30 p.m. on November 25, 2024.[[0:00:30]] During public testimony, an attorney said he was confused about where the board stood in reviewing a complaint.[[0:03:01]] A member said a small working group would check if the board's gift guide is adequate and suggest improvements to the law.[[0:10:30]] All six members present voted to form that group.[[0:10:48]] A member reported that voters approved a charter amendment to give the board full-time staff.[[0:11:41]] A member moved to approve a press release explaining why the board keeps its investigations confidential.[[0:14:59]] The motion passed with all six votes.[[0:18:42]] The board accepted financial disclosure statements from the director of the East Maui Water Authority.[[0:21:56]] The board voted six to go into executive session (a closed-door meeting) to discuss personnel matters and consult its attorney.[[0:24:34]] A member reported the board voted six to zero to put off two complaints until the staffing issue is resolved.[[0:27:29]] The next meeting is set for December 11, 2024, at 12:30 p.m.[[0:29:21]]
decided: The board voted to form a small working group to review its gift guide and suggest changes to gift laws.
The board approved a press release explaining its confidentiality rules and asked that it be sent out.
The board approved the draft minutes.
The board accepted the financial disclosure statements of the director of the East Maui Water Authority.
The board acknowledged receipt of two lobbyist terminations and their affiliated organizations.
The board voted to go into executive session to discuss personnel matters and consult its attorney.
In closed session, the board voted to deny reconsideration on item 5A1.
In closed session, the board voted to combine two agenda items into one matter.
In closed session, the board voted to decline to give an opinion on item 5B1.
In closed session, the board voted to deny the complaint in item 5B2.
In closed session, the board voted to set item 5B3 for an informal hearing.
In closed session, the board voted to deny the complaint in item 5B4.
In open session, the board voted to confirm the decisions reported from the closed session.
meeting.next: The chair and a member will meet with the managing director in December to talk about staffing. A member said the board must create positions, find a place and set a budget so staff are ready July 1. Staff will add two changes to the press release about finding past minutes and meeting recordings. A member will lead the next meeting in the chair's place while the chair attends a conference.

moments.q: "the charter Amendment for full-time staff for this Maui Board of Ethics was granted"
